title: How to Convert DOCX to PDF with Claude MCP and Medux
description: Use a simple natural-language request to let Claude call Medux through MCP, upload a document from your terminal, convert it, and download the finished PDF.
operation: Use a simple natural-language request to let Claude call Medux through MCP, upload a document from your terminal, convert it, and download the finished PDF.
prompt: Use Medux to convert "Artificial Intelligence and Transformer Models.docx" to a PDF file. Upload the file using curl.
